activity_summary: You looked once into the yard before the play. The flag was up. The ground was already littered, and the light was October grey. You did not step out among them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked from the door and did not go into the yard.

entities.name: the Theatre yard
entities.context: Mentioned in The yard before the doors

facets.activity: Looked into the yard from the door
